_about: Hand-authored skills, merged into the generated pack by tools/extract/build_documents.py (apply_manual_content). Put entries under "entries", keyed by name, with the item's system fields. A new name is added, tagged sourcebook "Custom" unless you give one. A name his data already builds is ignored unless the entry says "_override": true, in which case only the fields you give are laid over his. Keys starting with _ are notes and never read. Full guide: docs/ADDING-CONTENT.md. Rebuild with: python tools/extract/build_documents.py --write

_example._note: An example of the shape. Copy entries from here into "entries" to use them.

Climb.description: An override changes only the fields it gives -- here, the description.

Spell Lore._note: Bug report 0.20.8:1 (2026-09-30): 'some lore skills Spell Lore, etc. are not usable, non-acquired'. The Player's Guide's entry (p.101) says Restricted: Yes and carries no non-acquired note, so the build cannot read this off the book; his statement is newer than the book and is laid over it here.
